entries.topic: DMart Ready breakeven in couple years
entries.delivered: Business is working towards expected medium to long-term targets.

summary: Management provides reliable directional guidance on store expansion and gross margin caps, consistently meeting or operating within stated long-term financial and operational parameters.
business: Avenue Supermarts Ltd (DMART) operates retail stores offering a wide range of products and runs the DMart Ready e-commerce business.
bull: Consistent store openings meeting the 40-60 annual target range.
Maintained gross margins strictly within the targeted 14% to 15% range.
Delivered steady annual revenue growth of over 15%.
bear: EBITDA margins showed slight compression down to around 7.1% to 8.0%.
Free cash flows remained negative in recent periods due to high investments.
Total borrowings increased over the last three balance sheets to INR 4,264 crores.
